content:
Mk3 user *just* saved.

I thought I found everyone in my circle. 

This morning I realized there is probably more … so I used AI  search my messages to find anyone I recommended a coldcard to.

I found this guy who is a filmmaker friend of my sister’s.

He had setup an mk3 and didn’t move it yet.

He saw a warning email from @BeaverBitcoin_ but he wasn’t sure if it affected him, and he was busy working on a project.

I called him. He got into gear when I told him how serious it is.

He’s non-technical but he thinks he did the dice rolling.

If so that’s what saved him.

Just got his funds rescued an hour ago. Was a bit of a touch & go situation because he originally sent it with a low fee.

So keep reaching out! There’s lots of ppl out there who are still at risk on mk3s!
